title: Male borrowers who emphasize family partnership and specify child ages may fund faster.
Pitches from women that connect the need for funding to both the support of children's education and the growth of business income accelerate funding.
Female borrowers who express direct gratitude to lenders may fund faster.
Including logistical minutiae such as operating hours or travel distance predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who explain the specific financial motivation for a purchase fund faster.
Male borrowers who mention specific academic successes of their children fund faster.
Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention a specific field partner or training program may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who list specific products or equipment to be purchased may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who use abstract language like 'dreams' to describe goals fund more slowly.
Technical specificity regarding business inputs and goals predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Female borrowers who specify the number of children or dependents fund faster.
